details:
- Initial backport of PostgreSQL 11.22 for RHEL 7
- Based on Fedora/RHEL 8 spec files for PostgreSQL 10 and 12
- Adapted for RHEL 7 compatibility:
  - Disabled ICU support by default (not readily available on RHEL 7)
  - Disabled plpython3 by default (may need SCL for Python 3)
  - Removed perl-generators BuildRequires
  - Removed multilib-rpm-config BuildRequires
  - Added libs, devel subpackages for libpq and other shared libraries
